# RiffSmith neural capture attribution

These unmodified files are copied from https://github.com/hartmamt/riffsmith. The upstream README explicitly states that the author Matt Hartman trained the captures on his own rigs using the TONE3000 trainer and released them under the repository MIT license. The complete copyright and license notice is in LICENSE.txt.

| riffsmith-distorted.nam | 07a71a194c6cac68038a1408e8d42addb7211df7 | 48 kHz SlimmableContainer, amp + cab |

Source paths: public/nam/models/riffsmith-clean.nam and public/nam/models/riffsmith-distorted.nam. Upstream README blob: 37931d08335e851b23654bef4e218a7c206ef126. Upstream LICENSE blob: 7604aa15d902fe9dc6d302fe8ee5cd237405cba0. Retrieved November 26, 2026.

No model weights have been modified. The browser requests the smaller supported submodel by default. Neither the author nor TONE3000 is represented as endorsing Online Guitar Tuner. No commercial amplifier brand or specific artist tone is claimed for these captures. The engine and other models have separate licenses.

## ToneTinkerer virtual circuit models

Unmodified MIT-licensed original virtual amplifier circuit models from [ToneTinkerer](https://github.com/Tinkercaster/tonetinkerer), with explicit redistribution provenance in [ASSETS.md](https://github.com/Tinkercaster/tonetinkerer/blob/main/ASSETS.md). These are NOT measurements of real commercial amplifiers. The models are 48 kHz amp-only WaveNet captures, using the studio cabinet path. See TONETINKERER-LICENSE.txt.

- `tonetinkerer-crunch.nam`: upstream `assets/models/crunch.nam`, Git blob `4773c3a718a104a4113be85635336809ebc103d0`.
- `tonetinkerer-lead.nam`: upstream `assets/models/lead.nam`, Git blob `9cd43017b2bb9cd86daaca455670fe48d2730a03`.
- MIT license upstream blob `07cbae310b9f1e2fac2c8209981ee215397437cf`. Retrieved November 26, 2026.
